items.title: Retrospectively Reverse-Engineering Apple's Neural Engine
items.title_zh: 回顾 Apple 神经引擎（ANE）的逆向工程
items.summary: The author, who previously worked on a reverse-engineered Apple Neural Engine driver, revisits that effort and argues the ANE's opinionated architecture kept it from becoming a general-purpose accelerator. He also notes that even macOS mostly relies on the ANE to generate upsampled preview images in Finder, and that Apple's M5 placed the ANE cores inside the GPU cores.

items.title: We must pace the frontier
items.title_zh: 我们必须掌控前沿的节奏
items.summary: In a personal post, Dario Amodei writes that twelve years of work on AI have convinced him the technology could dramatically improve human life, potentially curing most major diseases within 5-10 years, while cautioning that its risks are serious because it is so powerful.

items.title: How to buy a good car for $1000
items.title_zh: 如何用 1000 美元买到一辆好车
items.summary: A personal essay on the cultural knowledge of the bottom 40%, framed around how to buy a good car for $1,000.

items.title: Google stole open source code without crediting the authors (Artemis/Minitap)
items.title_zh: Google 窃取开源代码且未署名（Artemis/Minitap）
items.summary: Minitap CEO Nico describes what his team found in Google's Artemis repository and argues that proper attribution matters for the open-source community. The post's title alleges that Google used open-source code without crediting the authors.

items.title: Pandas Should Go Extinct
items.title_zh: Pandas 该退出历史舞台了
items.summary: An argument that the pandas library has carried Python data work a long way, but that it is time for a replacement.

items.title: google.com/goto: Google's anti-scraping update
items.title_zh: google.com/goto：Google 的反爬虫更新
items.summary: Google is rolling out google.com/goto redirect URLs in search results, a change the post says is aimed at scrapers; Autom also explains how it updated its Google Search API in response.

items.title: Navier-Stokes Announcement
items.title_zh: Navier-Stokes 公告
items.summary: A Clay Mathematics Institute announcement page recounts the 2000 launch of the Millennium Prize Problems in Paris, the set of difficult challenges the institute posed for mathematicians.

items.title: Usenet rewind archive search engine
items.title_zh: Usenet Rewind 归档搜索引擎
items.summary: Usenet Rewind indexes text posts from hundreds of thousands of newsgroups, covering 1981 through today, and makes the archive searchable.

items.title: An atlas of periodic solutions to the three-body problem
items.title_zh: 三体问题周期解图谱
items.summary: The site maps 3,942 periodic solutions to the three-body problem, each precomputed to machine precision and animated through a single period, and lets visitors open and rank them.

items.title: Fuck it, make it anyway
items.title_zh: 管他呢，先做出来
items.summary: Joel, a software developer who runs the small indie game studio Bearwaves and is also a published poet, makes the case for building the thing anyway.

items.title: I made a build visualizer to understand Bun's compile times
items.title_zh: 为弄清 Bun 编译耗时，我做了个构建可视化工具
items.summary: The author built buildprof, an open-source tracing tool that shows where time goes when compiling software on Linux, and demonstrates it on a clean build of ripgrep. He created it to understand Bun's compile times.

items.title: Nvidia is the central bank of AI
items.title_zh: 英伟达是 AI 的中央银行
items.summary: An Economist briefing argues that Nvidia has come to play a central-bank-like role in the AI economy.

items.title: Compressing a flag to 11 bits
items.title_zh: 把一个 flag 压缩到 11 比特
items.summary: A short technical post about compressing a flag down to 11 bits.

items.title: Make your first edit to OpenStreetMap
items.title_zh: 完成你的第一次 OpenStreetMap 编辑
items.summary: A tutorial aimed at technically savvy readers walks through a first OpenStreetMap contribution in under 15 minutes: adding an official website tag to a nearby shop or amenity.

items.title: Reversing Factorio's RNG
items.title_zh: 逆向 Factorio 的随机数生成器
items.summary: The post breaks down Factorio's random number generation and shows how the author reversed it, then used only in-game mechanics to predict and control the RNG.

items.title: 4,400-Year-Old Tomb of Egyptian Judge Found at Saqqara with Colors on Walls
items.title_zh: 埃及法官的 4400 年古墓在萨卡拉出土，墓壁色彩犹存
items.summary: Archaeologists have uncovered the Saqqara tomb of the Egyptian judge Younmin and his father Ity, dated to 4,400 years ago and still bearing colored reliefs and a false door.

items.title: Linux Zoom client proactively reading everything written to X11 clipboard
items.title_zh: Linux 版 Zoom 客户端主动读取 X11 剪贴板的所有内容
items.summary: A user reports that an update to the Linux Zoom client began proactively reading everything written to the X11 clipboard, a concern for anyone who copies secrets or moves passwords through a password manager.

items.title: An open letter to Dario: if you mean it, open the weights
items.title_zh: 致 Dario 的公开信：若当真，就开放权重
items.summary: An open letter to Dario Amodei says his 'We Must Pace the Frontier' post committed Anthropic to embedded third-party evaluators and asked governments to require every other frontier company to match, with Sam Altman agreeing within hours. The author urges Amodei to support a different law that would actually slow AI progress, even though it would require real sacrifice from him.

items.title: LG says we're fake news [video]
items.title_zh: LG 称我们是假新闻【视频】
items.summary: Gamers Nexus says LG has responded to its Data Dragnet investigation by calling the outlet's reporting fake news.

items.title: Show HN: Redis City – Explore how Redis works in an interactive 3D model
items.title_zh: Show HN：Redis City——用交互式 3D 模型探索 Redis 的工作原理
items.summary: Redis City is an interactive 3D model that walks through Redis internals, showing how commands are parsed, keys are looked up, memory is allocated in pages, and data is persisted through RDB and AOF.

items.title: Real-SWE: Benchmarking AI models on private, real-world, enterprise codebases
items.title_zh: Real-SWE：在私有真实企业代码库上评测 AI 模型
items.summary: Real-SWE tests frontier AI models on private codebases drawn from real companies' production systems; the benchmark covers seventeen models and twenty-five tasks.

items.title: P(doom)
items.title_zh: P(doom)：末日概率
items.summary: Reacting to a viral round of 'AI is going to kill us all' discussion, the author notes that Dario Amodei's apparent P(doom) is between 10% and 25% and that Amodei's pacing essay drew agreement from Sam Altman and Musk. He recommends reading the post but says he is in strong opposition to it despite sharing its observations and much of its concern.

items.title: Don't be the out of touch Kung Fu master
items.title_zh: 别做脱离现实的功夫大师
items.summary: A short post cautioning against becoming an out-of-touch 'kung fu master.'

items.title: Japan's book scene is moving from bookstores to libraries
items.title_zh: 日本图书市场正从书店转向图书馆
items.summary: A piece on Japan's book culture shifting from bookstores to libraries, as small local libraries become travel destinations.

items.title: zjwzcx/Awesome-Astra-Embodied-AI
items.title_zh: Awesome-Astra-Embodied-AI：GPT-6 Astra 具身智能资源集
items.summary: A GitHub repository collecting resources on GPT-6 Astra for embodied AI and robotics.

items.title: ardeyouxipianyi/workbuddy2api-hub
items.title_zh: workbuddy2api-hub：WorkBuddy 多账号反向代理网关
items.summary: A Python gateway that turns WorkBuddy accounts into a multi-account reverse proxy supporting Codex, Claude Code, DSH and standard OpenAI clients.

items.title: youngyangyang04/llm-master
items.title_zh: llm-master：大模型全栈学习路线与中文教程
items.summary: A Chinese-language full-stack LLM curriculum, running from beginner material to production practice, that covers prompt engineering, RAG, AI agents, MCP, fine-tuning, model deployment, Transformers, AI coding and big-tech interview prep.

items.title: agentverse-os/AgentVerse-OS
items.title_zh: AgentVerse-OS：开发者与 AI Agent 的个人云操作系统
items.summary: AgentVerse-OS turns a single Ubuntu server into a personal cloud OS for a developer and their AI agents, reachable through a browser with a windowed desktop and isolated workspaces preloaded with VS Code, Claude Code and Codex, plus a store of 944 self-hosted apps. Traffic is limited to Tailscale, and the stack pairs a Rust core with a Svelte UI.

items.title: yifanzhang-pro/recurrent-looped-tranformer
items.title_zh: Recurrent Looped Transformer（RLT）官方项目主页
items.summary: The official project page for the Recurrent Looped Transformer (RLT), linked to its arXiv paper.

items.title: shilapi/xcertplay
items.title_zh: xcertplay：在 Android 车机上运行 CarPlay
items.summary: A Kotlin project that brings CarPlay to Android head units using the onboard MFi chip or a CH341 adapter.

items.title: linguo2625469/workbuddy2api-panel
items.title_zh: workbuddy2api-panel：腾讯 WorkBuddy 账号转 OpenAI 兼容 API
items.summary: A Go project that turns Tencent WorkBuddy accounts into an OpenAI-compatible multi-account gateway, automatically completes task-center tasks and adds a web admin panel for account pools, points tasks and live config updates; it is an enhanced fork of Sliverkiss/workbuddy2api.

items.title: Leviidev/Husk
items.title_zh: Husk：在 iOS 上运行 Android
items.summary: Husk is a Java project for running Android on iOS, either natively or emulated.

items.title: Chuloo/mural
items.title_zh: mural：通过对话学习语言的 iPhone 应用
items.summary: Mural is a native iPhone app for learning languages through conversation, presented as the language app you eventually delete.

items.title: Clearailhc/clearai-dsh
items.title_zh: ClearAI：以本体为核心的原生 DSH 插件
items.summary: ClearAI is an ontology-first DSH agent preset that turns evidence-checked research into a browsable domain ontology.

items.title: SiliconBench: Speed, Memory, and Fidelity for LLM Serving on Unified-Memory Desktops
items.title_zh: SiliconBench：统一内存桌面端 LLM 服务的速度、内存与保真度
items.summary: SiliconBench evaluates nine Apple Silicon LLM serving engines on speed, memory and fidelity for chat and agent workloads with Qwen3, Qwen3.5 and Gemma 4, using an NVIDIA reference for quality regressions and DGX Spark as a complementary serving-performance reference. The study reports that explicit memory budgets do not guarantee memory headroom, that newer model architectures have narrower engine support, and that only three stacks satisfy the completion, fidelity and model-coverage gates.

items.title: A Machine Learning Framework for Fault Detection, Isolation, and Severity Prediction of Autonomous VTOL Aircraft
items.title_zh: 自主 VTOL 飞行器故障检测、隔离与严重程度预测的机器学习框架
items.summary: The study develops a CNN framework that learns spatio-temporal patterns from multivariate flight dynamics to infer both the faulted rotor and its damage level on autonomous VTOL aircraft, validated first on simulated data and then on a hexacopter with controlled blade-tip breakage. It reports rotor-wise fault classification accuracies above 99% and 96% severity estimation accuracy within a 1% tolerance on experimental data.

items.title: Bi-Level Routing and Sparse Spatial Attention based Multi-View BEV 3D Object Detection for Autonomous Driving
items.title_zh: 基于双层路由与稀疏空间注意力的多视角 BEV 三维目标检测
items.summary: Sparse-BEVNet introduces bi-level routing attention into the image feature extraction backbone, cascaded group attention in the feature fusion module, and a sparse spatial cross-attention mechanism replacing dense view projection for multi-view BEV 3D object detection. On the nuScenes dataset it reports 45.2% mAP and 54.5% NDS, improvements of 3.6% and 2.8% over the baseline.

items.title: When Tools Get in the Way: The Effect of Unnecessary Tool Availability on LLM Answering
items.title_zh: 当工具成为阻碍：不必要的工具可用性对 LLM 回答的影响
items.summary: The authors construct 500 query pairs across 10 knowledge domains, each pairing a tool-requiring query with a closed-domain query that does not need the tool, and evaluate six LLMs with the tool unavailable, available, and available after a prior tool call. The pooled answer rate fell from 98.2% at baseline to 63.5% when an unnecessary tool was available, a drop that occurred even when the tool was rarely called, and a one-sentence scope-aware system instruction recovered most of the lost answers.

items.title: 3D Gait-Based Autism Classification Using Attention-Enhanced Deep Learning with Cross-Fold Statistical Stability Analysis
items.title_zh: 基于注意力增强深度学习与交叉折叠统计稳定性分析的三维步态自闭症分类
items.summary: The study proposes an attention-enhanced Transformer framework for autism spectrum disorder classification from 3D gait features, evaluated on precomputed statistical gait descriptors and raw biomechanical ground-reaction-force measurements. Under five-fold cross-validation it reports 99.00% accuracy on the public Kinect-based benchmark and mean 95.00% accuracy on an independent private force-plate dataset.

items.title: Towards Evolving Context Parameterization for Large Language Models
items.title_zh: 面向大语言模型的演化式上下文参数化
items.summary: The authors formalize the Memory Updating with Sequential Evolution (MUSE) task and build MUSE-bench to evaluate how well context parameterization incorporates updates while preserving unaffected information. They propose PLUME, a training-free method that constructs a global update representation, activates memory evidence into a local parameter view, and adaptively integrates their predictions during decoding, reporting relative improvements of 29.9% in average ROUGE-L Recall and 54.9% in LLM-as-a-Judge on MUSE-bench.
